The evaluation metrics include informativeness, fluency, and non-redundancy. (1) Informativeness: Does the system summary contain comprehensive reference content? (2) Fluency: Is the system summary grammatically correct and readable? (3) Non-Redundancy: Does the system summary not have redundant or incorrect information relative to the input?
